evaluation_type: within-dataset descriptive proxy; not independent or campaign-outcome validation
dataset_name: Judge-rated dataset of nano- and micro-influencers
source_collection_date: Not disclosed; source describes a three-month observation period
comparison: Spearman correlation: judge-rated opinion leadership vs judge-rated intention to recommend

ranking_evaluation.metric: NDCG@10, target judge-rated intention to recommend
ranking_evaluation.scope: Same-sample retrospective ranking proxy, not a held-out evaluation

overall.relevance: judge-rated intention to recommend; graded gain 2^rating - 1

fitness.relevance: judge-rated intention to recommend; graded gain 2^rating - 1

beauty.relevance: judge-rated intention to recommend; graded gain 2^rating - 1

lifestyle.relevance: judge-rated intention to recommend; graded gain 2^rating - 1

travel.relevance: judge-rated intention to recommend; graded gain 2^rating - 1

candidate_fold_diagnostic.splitter: KFold(shuffle=True, random_state=42); each creator occurs in one candidate fold
candidate_fold_diagnostic.scope: This is a candidate-fold stability diagnostic, not model cross-validation: no model is fitted. Each fold ranks only its included creators using their observed opinion-leadership ratings and evaluates against their intention-to-recommend ratings from the same historical study. It is not independent outcome or campaign validation.

limitations: Same research sample supplies ranking and proxy target
Judge ratings are not observed campaign outcomes
Three-month observation window has no disclosed exact dates
